visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and round glasses, wearing a green utility jacket over a white t-shirt, sits in a studio-like setting. He speaks enthusiastically into a professional black microphone mounted on an arm. Behind him is a light-colored wall with a wooden shelf holding books and a globe. (2) Cut to a second man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a dark jacket, also speaking into a microphone. On-screen text identifies him as Henry Liu. He uses open-palm hand gestures to emphasize his points. (3) The first man is shown again, laughing heartily with his head tilted back and hand touching his neck. (4) The scene alternates back to Henry Liu, who continues his explanation with a serious but encouraging expression. (5) The video ends with a series of quick cuts between the two speakers as they conclude the conversation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The phase begins with an energetic male voice asking about interview experiences. A bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar BGM is present in the background. (2) A second, slightly lower-pitched male voice enters, responding with a calm but expressive tone, detailing the 'seven rounds' of interviews. (3) A brief reaction phase features the first voice laughing and exclaiming with high vocal arousal. (4) The second voice continues his narrative, describing the psychological pressure and uncertainty post-interview. The music remains steady, providing a warm, positive bed. (5) The final phase features a motivational conclusion from the second speaker with a rising intonation, accompanied by a bright bell-like SFX for emphasis as the music fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Question -> Personal Experience -> Advice
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demystify the Meta interview process and encourage job seekers by sharing a first-hand experience of a former senior engineer who succeeded despite coming from a non-elite background.
